Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) spreading via WhatsApp and SMS messages
Camouflaged as fake WhatsApp updates exploiting CVE-2019-3568 vulnerability
Uses Android Accessibility Service to interact with other apps
Unlocks devices, collects device info, turns off screen to run background tasks, uninstalls itself and removes infection traces
Attack Vector: Messages delivered via WhatsApp or SMS
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample MD5 hashes provided by Kaspersky researchers
